# Copilot instructions for this repository

## Project
This is a simple static website. It has one page: index.html.

## Coding rules
- Use plain HTML only. Do not add JavaScript or CSS frameworks.
- Keep the code indented with 2 spaces.
- Every new section must have a heading (h2).

## Security rules
- Never put passwords, API keys or tokens in any file.
- Never add links to external scripts.

## Process rules
- Only change the files the task asks for.
- After making changes, list every file you changed and explain why in one sentence each.
